static void *

{
	p = realloc(p, n);
	if (p == NULL) {

static char *
slurp(FILE *fp, size_t *final_len)
{
	size_t len = 256;

	char *l = (char *)xrealloc(NULL, len), *s = l;

	for (c = getc(fp); c != EOF; c = getc(fp)) {
		if (s == l + len) {

			len *= 2;
		}
		*s++ = c;
	}
	if (s == l + len)

	*s++ = '\0';

	*final_len = s - l;
	l = (char *)xrealloc(l, s - l);
	return l;
